item.title: Programa 2025
item.description:
Día 1 — Tuesday, October 21st

Día Horario Actividad Personas clave Sala / notas
Tuesday, October 21st 09:00–15:00 GNI Meeting of Members and Board Meeting (open agenda) - Rooms 2-2 & 2-3 (by invitation only)
- 09:00–11:00 Desayuno AlSur - Room 4-4 (closed event)
- 17:00–18:00 Recapitulando: 25 años de Fundación Vía Libre - Auditorio (by invitation only, Spanish)
- 18:00–20:00 Vía Libre 25 años Happy Hour - Terrace (by invitation only)
- 20:00 GNI Dinner - By invitation only

Día 2 — Wednesday, October 22nd

Día Horario Actividad Personas clave Sala / notas
Wednesday, October 22nd 08:30–13:15 GNI Closed Board Meeting Agenda - Room 2-3 (by invitation only)
- 09:00–16:00 Wikimedia Día Cero: “La utopía digital: resignificando Internet y las tecnologías digitales” - Room 2-2 (by invitation only, Spanish)
- 09:00–17:00 Onboarding AlSur - Room 4-4 (closed event)
- 17:00–17:30 GNI Annual Learning Forum: Navigating global paradigm shifts to protect digital rights (Introduction) Vicky Bowman, Jason Pielemeier, Agustina Del Campo, Fulvio Santarelli Auditorio
- 17:30–18:30
PLENARY SESSION #1: Protecting human rights amidst emerging content regulation regimesPanel sobre impactos en DDHH de nuevos regímenes de regulación de contenidos.
 Amalia Toledo, Usama Khilji, Alexandria Walden, Rafael Zanatta, moderator: Agustina Del Campo Auditorio
- 18:45–19:45
PLENARY SESSION #2: Understanding the human rights implications of government interventions in AI technologiesPanel sobre implicancias en DDHH de intervenciones estatales sobre tecnologías de IA.
 Mishi Choudhary, Cristian Leon, Nick Pelosi, Miranda Sissons, Marlena Wisniak, moderator: Min Aung Auditorio
- 19:45–19:55 Closing remarks - Auditorio
- 20:00 Opening Reception sponsored by Google - Terrace (open event)

Día 3 — Thursday, October 23rd

Día Horario Track 1 (Auditorio) Track 2 (2-2) Track 3 (2-3)
Thursday, October 23rd 08:00–08:30 Registration (breakfast will be served) - -
- 08:30–09:00 Welcome and Introductory remarks — Agustina Del Campo (CELE) - -
- 09:00–10:30 Social Media Monetization — Implications for LATAM (Victoire Rio, WhatToFix) AI Governance and Freedom of Expression – A Global Overview (Jordi Calvet, Future of Free Speech) Desórdenes de información en el sur global: resiliencia digital (Verónica Mery Leon, Critica)
- 10:30–10:45 coffee break - -
- 10:45–12:30 Buzzwords and Fake Concepts in Internet Regulation (Vladimir Garay). Moderator: Agustina Del Campo Building Safer Online Spaces / Prosocial Tech (Kristin Hansen) + Content Moderation & Hate Speech Prevention (Emmanuel Diokh) Censura: bloqueos/filtrados y shadow banning (Carolina Martínez Elebi, Vladimir Cortés) + bloqueo de DNS (Carolina Aguerre)
- 12:30–13:30 lunch / almuerzo - -
- 13:30–15:30
PLENARY SESSION #3Presentation of Guidelines for CSOs engaging ICT companies in conflict/high-risk areas + panel “A war of words: armed conflicts, internet regulation, and online censorship”.
 - -
- 15:30–16:00 coffee break - -
- 16:00–17:30 State surveillance in the global south (Usama Khilji, Arturo Carrillo, Ana Gaitán, Rafael Zanatta, Montserrat Legorreta) Exploring Three Forms of Digital Governance to Protect Rights Online (Hilary Ross, Juliane Müller, Jason Pielemeier, Ramiro Álvarez Ugarte) Wikimedia’s Human Rights Impact Assessment on AI/ML & AI Strategy (Richard Gaines)
- 20:00 Cocktail sponsored by Meta (limited spaces, registration required) - -

Día 4 — Friday, October 24th

Día Horario Track 1 (Auditorio) Track 2 (2-2) Track 3 (2-3)
Friday, October 24th 08:00–09:30 Meta’s Breakfast: Discussion on Brazil’s Legislative Landscape - By invitation only
- 09:30–11:00 Equality and non-discrimination in AI Regulation in Latin America (Rafael Zanatta, Juan Carlos Lara, Mariana Valente, Dilmar Villena) Fixing The Fix. The Public Health Turn in Technology Regulation (Ramiro Álvarez Ugarte) Perspectivas regulatorias en AL: moderación pública en Chile + regulación de plataformas en Uruguay (Javier Gallegos, Matias Jackson, Carolina Martínez Elebi)
- 11:00–11:40 fire drill + coffee break - -
- 11:40–13:00 Avoiding the Platform Transparency Trap (Shashank Mohan, Juan Diego Castañeda) GenAI & LLMs in Content Moderation – Rights & Risks (Marlena Wizniak) Violencia de género en línea: tres perspectivas (Dilmar Villena, Jéssica Bárcenas, Laura Mantilla León)
- 13:00–14:00 lunch / almuerzo - -
- 14:00–15:30 AI governance: rights-based approaches + multistakeholder dialogue (Alexandria Walden, Elonnai Hickok, Shashank Mohan) Techno-Authoritarianism: Democratic Backsliding, Free Expression & Rule of Law (Berin Szoka) Estrategias de incidencia digital para sociedad civil (Gastón Wright, Javier Pallero)
- 15:30–15:45 coffee break - -
- 15:45–17:00 Business and Human Rights amidst Geopolitical Disruption (Bennett Freeman) Fundamental Rights & DSA + State of Freedom of Expression under DSA (Tracy Manners, Andrew Smith, Joan Barata) Desafíos de incidencia en América Latina ante el “efecto Trump” (Claudio Ruiz)
- 17:00–17:15 Closing remarks — Agustina Del Campo - Room: Auditorio
